subject: Thank You For Applying!
bodySnippet: Thank you so much for your application. As soon as the role has closed we will be in touch to provide an outcome and details of the next steps if you are shortlisted for interview.
notes: Generic Workday application confirmation. Should not go to Review Inbox if confidence is high enough.

subject: Has enviado correctamente tu candidatura para el puesto AI Software Development Engineer en FERROVIAL CORPORACIÓN, S.A.U.
bodySnippet: Hemos recibido correctamente tu candidatura para el puesto AI Software Development Engineer. We will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.
notes: Spanish confirmation. Keywords include enviado correctamente, candidatura, hemos recibido correctamente.

subject: Se ha enviado tu solicitud a Hover, Inc.
bodySnippet: Embedded Software Engineer. Hover, Inc. Solicitado el 1 de mayo de 2026. Ahora sigue estos pasos para llegar aún más lejos.
notes: LinkedIn Spanish application sent confirmation. Should extract company and role from body card, not sender.

subject: Solicitud en Indeed: Diseñador Front End
bodySnippet: Tu solicitud ha sido enviada. Los siguientes documentos se han enviado a OFIMATICA TSS, S.L.: Solicitud, CV. Buena suerte.
notes: Indeed Spanish confirmation. Do not use Indeed as company.

subject: Hover, Inc ha visto tu solicitud
bodySnippet: Han visto tu solicitud. El equipo de selección de Hover, Inc se ha fijado en ti. Embedded Software Engineer. Hover, Inc. Solicitado el 1 may.
notes: Application viewed is not a new application, not rejection, not task. It should attach to existing Hover application if possible.

subject: Tu actualización de RedTech Recruitment
bodySnippet: Thank you for your application to RedTech Recruitment. We wanted to let you know that shortlisting for this stage of the recruitment process has now concluded. Unfortunately, we will not be progressing your application on this occasion.
notes: LinkedIn rejection. Should update matching existing application, not create a new application.

subject: Tu solicitud para el puesto de Java Developer en Diverger
bodySnippet: Gracias por tu interés en el puesto de Java Developer en Diverger. Hemos decidido no seguir con tu proceso de selección, pero agradecemos mucho tu tiempo e interés.
notes: Spanish rejection. Strong rejection phrases: no seguir con tu proceso, no continuaremos, no avanzar, no seleccionado.

subject: GetYourGuide Interview Request
bodySnippet: Thank you for your interest in the Associate Software Engineer position at GetYourGuide. We're excited to move forward with the interview process. To help us schedule your next interview, please select a time through the Calendly link below.
notes: Interview request should create a task and attach to existing application if possible.

subject: AI interview is complete
bodySnippet: Thank you for completing your AI interview with micro1. We appreciate the time and effort you put in.
notes: Completion confirmation should mark existing matching task as done and remove it from active tasks.

subject: Alertas de empleo: Ingeniero de software
bodySnippet: Tu alerta de empleo para Ingeniero de software. Nuevos empleos coinciden con tus preferencias. Solicitar ahora.
notes: Job alert. Not an application, rejection, interview, or task.

subject: Our recommendation: Senior Software Developer
bodySnippet: We recommend this job for you. Take a look and see if you want to apply. Good fit.
notes: Recommendation email. Should not create pending application or task.
